title: llmspeed lets buyers feel local-model performance before choosing a GPU
friendlyTitle: Try the speed of a local AI setup before buying a GPU
summary: llmspeed is an interactive comparison tool that simulates how different local model, quantization and hardware combinations feel, including estimated token speed and time to first token. Users can compare configurations before buying equipment.
friendlySummary: llmspeed shows how fast different AI models may respond on different graphics cards and settings.
whyItMatters: Local-AI purchases are easy to over- or under-size using memory figures alone. A responsiveness-oriented comparison can narrow the shortlist, though buyers should still confirm estimates against measured benchmarks and their actual prompts.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help you avoid buying hardware that feels too slow or costs more than you need.
